confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026, prices in USD (Panama uses USD). July is early rainy season, not peak tourist season, so no seasonal premium is applied. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain; cocktail and wine are inferred from the beer price because direct knowledge is weaker. Accommodation anchors are the least certain because taxes and service charges vary by property. The FX value comes from search-result summaries of RBA data, and I could not see the RBA table text directly, so verify it on rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked loosely against San José, Costa Rica, a Central American capital with similar traveller infrastructure, adjusted upward for Panama City's higher hotel and restaurant prices in the main visitor districts (Bella Vista, Punta Pacífica, Costa del Este, Casco Viejo).
